subject: general
question:
**In the given sentence the underlined word may have been incorrectly spelt. Identify the option that rectifies the spelling. If there is no error in spelling, select ‘No error’.**

The __ameteur__ sculptor received an award at the international sculpting competition.
solution:
The correct answer is **'amateur'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling and meaning is:
 
• **Amateur - **a person who is incompetent at a particular activity, unprofessional. (एक व्यक्ति जो किसी विशेष गतिविधि में अक्षम है)
 
 
• **Example:** Ridhi was a very **amateur **makeup artist.
 
 
 
• ​Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct sentence:**__ *The __**amateur**__ sculptor received an award at the international sculpting competition.*
